name: PumpOS
summary: The operating system for Indian fuel stations. Shifts, nozzles, cash, stock, credit and reports, finally in one record.

decision.title: The counter keeps moving even when the network doesn't.
decision.description: Built around an offline-ready desktop client that syncs when the connection returns, with event history and auditable business-day snapshots so staff can trace how a number became the number.

name: Hibah
summary: Recurring giving with a clear trail, from a donor's first enrollment link to the thank-you note.

decision.title: Stay out of the money. Keep every receipt.
decision.description: Donors pay the organisation directly over UPI. Hibah never touches the funds. It structures the rest: reference verification, contribution state, team roles and reminders, so the ledger holds up without a payment gateway in the middle.

name: tqwp
summary: A Go worker pool for concurrent tasks, with retries you control instead of retries that control you.

decision.title: Expose retries without making the happy path harder.
decision.description: A small Go package. Enqueue tasks, process them with a pool of workers, decide exactly how failures get another go. Nothing else.

name: ohmytheme
summary: A native macOS theme engine. Change one colour scheme and every developer tool on your machine follows.

name: Holy Quran
summary: A Raycast audio player for the Quran. Pick a reciter, set a verse range, loop it, and keep listening offline.

name: Unigro
summary: Pool money with people you trust, and let everyone see where it went. Built for organisers and members alike.
